description: Today, we join in mourning the tragic loss of Aysenur Ezgi Eygi, a beloved Turkish-American dual citizen and University of Washington alum, who was killed by Israeli forces during a protest in the West Bank. Aysenur’s death is a heartbreaking reminder of the immense human cost of this ongoing conflict, and we grieve with her […]
